description: A row in stores identical in every column to an earlier row is a copy; the first is kept and the copies are quarantined.
Every stores value must parse as its column type.
stores.opening_date accepts YYYY-MM-DD and DD-MM-YYYY; day-first dates are converted. Other formats and impossible dates are quarantined.
stores.area_sqft must be greater than 0.
stores.store_type must be one of: Express, Hypermarket, Supermarket.
Each store_id must identify one row in stores. When several valid rows share it with different values, all of them are quarantined.
stores.opening_date after the run date is impossible. No KPI uses it, so the row is kept and flagged.
A row in articles identical in every column to an earlier row is a copy; the first is kept and the copies are quarantined.
Every articles value must parse as its column type.
articles.purchase_price must be greater than 0.
articles.recommended_selling_price must be greater than 0.
Each article_id must identify one row in articles. When several valid rows share it with different values, all of them are quarantined.
An article whose purchase price is above its recommended selling price loses money on every sale at that price. It may be deliberate, so it is kept and flagged.
A row in transactions identical in every column to an earlier row is a copy; the first is kept and the copies are quarantined.
Blank, N/A, NA, NULL and NONE in transactions.customer_id (any case) all mean 'no value' and are stored as null.
Every transactions value must parse as its column type.
transactions.date accepts YYYY-MM-DD and DD-MM-YYYY; day-first dates are converted. Other formats and impossible dates are quarantined.

Dates after the run date are impossible. When transaction ids are in date order, such a row takes the date of the preceding transaction id and is flagged with its original date; otherwise it is quarantined.
transactions.currency must be one of: KRS, TRY.
Prices recorded in kurus (KRS) are converted to lira (TRY): 100 KRS = 1 TRY.
Quantity must be positive. Negative quantities may be returns, but nothing links them to an original sale, so they are quarantined and reported as possible returns.
transactions.selling_price must be greater than 0.
transactions.discount_pct must be between 0 and 100.
Each transaction_id must identify one row in transactions. When several valid rows share it with different values, all of them are quarantined.
Every store_id in transactions must exist in stores.
Every article_id in transactions must exist in articles.
A selling price more than 50% away from the article's recommended price suggests a unit or entry error. The sale is kept and flagged.
A row in inventory identical in every column to an earlier row is a copy; the first is kept and the copies are quarantined.
Every inventory value must parse as its column type.
inventory.date accepts YYYY-MM-DD and DD-MM-YYYY; day-first dates are converted. Other formats and impossible dates are quarantined.
inventory.opening_stock must be at least 0.
inventory.received_qty must be at least 0.
inventory.sold_qty must be at least 0.
inventory.closing_stock must be at least 0.
Each date/store_id/article_id must identify one row in inventory. When several valid rows share it with different values, all of them are quarantined.
Every store_id in inventory must exist in stores.
Every article_id in inventory must exist in articles.
opening_stock + received_qty - sold_qty should equal closing_stock. Rows that do not balance are kept, using the reported stock levels, and flagged.
